Family reunification
eViza | Ministerul Afacerilor Externe

docs.text: Marriage certificate or proof of family ties/partnership (Romanian citizen sponsor)
IGI family reunification approval (valid 60 days) for third-country sponsors
Proof of housing, means of support and health insurance (third-country sponsor cases)
Criminal record certificate
2 photos
Valid passport (3 months beyond departure, 2 blank pages, issued within 10 years)
Travel medical insurance (minimum EUR 30,000)
Sponsor in Romania: application form, translated and legalized marriage/birth certificate, proof of dwelling, means of support, health insurance

docs.text: Individual employment contract registered in REGES
Criminal record certificate (translated and legalized)
Proof of funds: minimum gross basic salary for 90 days (highly qualified workers exempt)
Travel medical insurance, minimum EUR 30,000
2 photos
Copy of valid passport
D/AM2: placement contract / service contract plus employment contract
After entry: single permit application at IGI at least 30 days before visa expiry (application, passport, proof of living space, medical certificate, fees)

D/AR: endorsement from the State Secretariat for Faiths, proof of funds, accommodation

entryRules.note: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period (Regulation (EU) 2018/1806). HK/MO: SAR passports only; TW: passports with personal identity number.
Up to 90 days in any 180-day period; holders of biometric passports only.

Short-stay visa required; some nationalities also need an invitation endorsed by the General Inspectorate for Immigration. Holders of a valid Schengen multi-entry visa, long-stay visa or residence permit may enter without a Romanian visa (90/180 days).
